mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, sku, name, attributes, price, stock, is_active AS active, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM product_variants WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT id, product_id, sku, name, attributes, price, stock, is_active AS active, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM product_variants WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, product_id, sku, name, attributes, price, stock, is_active AS active, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM product_variants WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_variants (product_id, sku, name, attributes, price, stock, is_active) VALUES (#{productId}, #{sku}, #{name}, #{attributes,typeHandler=com.example.ecommerce.config.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_variants SET sku = #{sku}, name = #{name}, attributes = #{attributes,typeHandler=com.example.ecommerce.config.JsonMapTypeHandler}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, is_active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE product_variants SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE product_variants SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{variantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
